fieldData.awb---how-to-step-2-des: A visitor who never presses play still needs the offer. Put the headline and the main call to action beside or under the video, and write the headline so it makes sense on its own. The video adds proof; the page carries the ask.

fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Clinics with 10 or more therapists skip the line

Cobaltine, scheduling software for physical therapy clinics, sends 200 invites every Monday at 9 AM. Its early access form asks how many therapists a clinic has, and clinics with 10 or more skip ahead to the next batch. Tamberlane Physio signed up with 14 therapists, and founder Lennart Sefton got a Slack message.

awb---key-feature-1-image.alt: Tamarack Payroll's demo page shows a New York visitor the start time as 2:00 PM Eastern, read from her browser, with the host's 11:00 AM Pacific underneath.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: Tallyfield's webinar page now reads Watch the Recording, and its registrant table shows 412 live registrants and 268 replay sign-ups.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: Plumtree's onboarding series table counts seats for four sessions, and Bank Feeds, at 100 of 100, has switched to a waitlist.

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: Slateford People's panel page groups 86 registrant questions by topic, led by pay ranges with 31, and sends the list to moderator Lena Sowande at 8 AM.
